title: Changelog
intro: What changed in GlassFolio, release after release.

v1-3.title: More accurate taxes, quests that move

highlights.peaWithdrawals: The declaration assistant now computes the taxable gain of your PEA withdrawals, with the income tax and social contributions due.
highlights.taxAccuracy: Tax figures are more accurate: up-to-date brackets and rates, amounts in foreign currencies converted at the rate of their day, and a crypto portfolio that counts staking rewards and exchanges.
highlights.quests: Quests now follow what you actually do each month and quarter, and a reward to claim is announced in your notifications.
highlights.localDemo: A self-hosted install no longer shows a demo button: start it with npm run dev:demo to open the demo account directly.
highlights.reliability: Many fixes: you stay signed in with Google after a refresh, data stays in sync across tabs, Escape closes windows, and every message is translated.

highlights.googleNoKey: Signing in with Google no longer asks you to look after a recovery key. You can create one whenever you want, from Settings, Security.
highlights.googleSmoother: Signing in with Google is more reliable: your two-factor code is asked before your vault opens, and a leftover from an old sign-in on this device no longer gets in the way.
highlights.googleDeletion: Deleting a Google account now also removes your key file from your Google Drive.
highlights.spheres: Loading screens use the animated sphere everywhere, and pull-to-refresh only shows on touch screens.

v1-1.title: Google sign-in, AI keys and privacy

highlights.googleVault: Sign in with Google: your vault key is kept in your own Google Drive app storage, so there is nothing to type or keep track of.
highlights.manualPrices: Prices you enter by hand are now stored inside your encrypted vault, including on your self-hosted server.
highlights.aiKeys: Each AI provider keeps its own API key, and the assistant conversation clears as soon as you lock the vault.
highlights.privacyNotice: A clearer privacy notice about the market data providers that see the tickers you follow.

highlights.vault: End-to-end client-side encrypted vault (AES-256-GCM) with passkey biometric unlock.
highlights.multiAssets: Complete multi-asset wealth tracking: PEA, brokerage, crypto, life insurance, and savings accounts.
highlights.importEngine: Universal import engine with smart format detection, column mapping, and statement reconciliation.
highlights.taxAssistant: French tax assistant: Cerfa 2042 / 3916-bis simulation, flat-tax vs progressive bracket comparison, and tax-loss harvesting.
highlights.aiAssistant: Private built-in AI copilot (local Ollama or BYOK API) with local MCP server for Claude Desktop & Cursor.
highlights.selfHostAndCloud: Secure cloud edition and self-hosted Docker container running entirely on your machine.
